**Debug log**
Settings → Application logs → tick *Debug mode*, do the thing again, then *Open the logs folder* and drag the newest `edch-debug_….log` here (and `edch-error_….log` if there is one). Logs are cleaned automatically: no API keys, codes, Windows user name or full IP addresses.
